description: This file implements the core logic for 'git config' command, including subcommands like list, get, set, unset, rename-section, remove-section, edit, and actions like get-color, get-colorbool, get-urlmatch. It handles configuration file location, parsing options, and executing the corresponding operations, with functions for normalization, validation, and display of configuration data.

methods.name: option_parse_type
methods.description: Parses the '--type' option argument, setting the type accordingly.

methods.name: check_argc
methods.description: Validates the number of command-line arguments against expected min and max.

methods.name: show_config_origin
methods.description: Displays the origin of a configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: show_config_scope
methods.description: Displays the scope of a configuration key-value pair.

methods.name: show_all_config
methods.description: Outputs all configuration key-value pairs with optional origin and scope info.

methods.name: format_config
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair into a string buffer based on display options.

methods.name: collect_config
methods.description: Collects configuration entries matching certain criteria into a list.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values matching key and regex patterns, with options.

methods.name: normalize_value
methods.description: Normalizes a configuration value based on its type.

methods.name: git_get_color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration for a given variable.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Gets the color value for a specified slot, printing to stdout.

methods.name: git_get_colorbool_config
methods.description: Retrieves boolean color configuration for a variable.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Gets the boolean color setting, optionally printing.

methods.name: check_write
methods.description: Checks if configuration can be written to the source.

methods.name: urlmatch_collect_fn
methods.description: Collects URL match configuration entries.

methods.name: get_urlmatch
methods.description: Retrieves configuration specific to URL matching.

methods.name: default_user_config
methods.description: Generates default user config content.

methods.name: location_options_init
methods.description: Initializes configuration location options based on environment and flags.

methods.name: location_options_release
methods.description: Releases resources allocated for location options.

methods.name: display_options_init
methods.description: Initializes display options for configuration output.

methods.name: cmd_config_list
methods.description: Handles 'git config list' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_get
methods.description: Handles 'git config get' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_set
methods.description: Handles 'git config set' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_unset
methods.description: Handles 'git config unset' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_rename_section
methods.description: Handles 'git config rename-section' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_remove_section
methods.description: Handles 'git config remove-section' command.

methods.name: show_editor
methods.description: Opens the configuration file in an editor for editing.

methods.name: cmd_config_edit
methods.description: Handles 'git config edit' command.

methods.name: cmd_config_actions
methods.description: Handles various 'git config' actions based on parsed options.

methods.name: cmd_config
methods.description: Main entry point for 'git config' command, dispatching subcommands or actions.
